You are explaining the concept of impurity to a colleague who is new to decision trees. Which of the following statements best describes impurity in the context of decision trees?
options: Impurity measures the purity of a node in terms of class distribution.
Impurity measures the level of randomness in the dataset.
Impurity measures the depth of a decision tree to prevent overfit problem.
Impurity measures the number of features in a dataset that are not relevant for classification.
correct: Impurity measures the purity of a node in terms of class distribution.
